users: Landed Cost Voucher New Selling Price now also re-prices carton/box Item Prices at price x conversion factor (was: set to the unit price); a box price in a UOM the item has no conversion for is left untouched; a newly created price carries the stock UOM.
Request Cancellation fast track (draft Delivery Note): only a requester who can read the invoice (role + company) gets the automatic cancel; others go through the normal request flow.

Draft Delivery Note deletion (and therefore the fast-track auto-cancel, which deletes the draft note) no longer cancels the Sales Order's Payment Entries: the money stays on the customer's account as an advance, as the message already said. A Sales Order cancelled from the desk still cancels its receipts.
Device check-in endpoint (add_checkin) now requires Employee Checkin create permission and respects Employee/Company User Permissions.
Commission: supplier refunds and other non-Customer Payment Entries no longer count, and no longer require a Sales Person; Payment Entry amounts are counted in company currency.
An invoice whose goods were only partly returned can no longer be cancelled (directly or by deleting another draft DN) until every unit is back; the guard also follows invoice amendments.

DN Returns: the uplift credit note for a price corrected upwards now carries the Sales Person (it was rejected before); returns of delivery-first notes now raise their credit note; rows no invoice can be found for are reported (alert + Error Log).
Changing or clearing an employee's default shift ends the running Shift Assignment the day before instead of cancelling it, so attendance deductions for earlier days stay.
Negative-stock automation counts pack lines in stock units and sums rows of one item, so carton sales no longer fail with Insufficient Stock where the automation should have armed.

Reconcile All needs Stock Reconciliation create permission; the broken-chain audit and the relink repair respect the caller's permissions; the outstanding-debt notice shows foreign-currency receivables in their own currency.
release_notes.connector_routes: No kit_pos connector route, response shape or status code is changed; no connector file is touched. The only change on the tills' path is server-side: negative_stock_handler.ensure_negative_stock_for_doc (Sales Invoice before_submit during materialization) now arms for pack lines, i.e. fewer NegativeStockError refusals. The sales-chain cancel guards (#182/#253) only bite where Delivery Notes exist (not on update_stock POS invoices).

migrate: none: no DocType schema change, no Custom Field, no fixture, no patch. Only core fields are read (stock_qty, conversion_factor, base_paid_amount, dn_detail, *_in_account_currency, Item Price.uom, Shift Assignment.end_date); safe on ddamu's un-migrated schema.
risks: #174: if the biometric sync token's user lacks Employee Checkin create (or is fenced by a Company User Permission), device punches will 403 and pile up in the PHP retry queue until the role is fixed: verify before deploy. Users with the hrms Employee role can still create their own punches (as upstream hrms).

#258 also changes the draft-DN fast-track auto-cancel: the SO's Receive Payment Entries now stay as customer advances (base cancelled them via the SO on_cancel). Intended per the delivery_note_handler design; the refund, if any, is a separate step.

#180: Attendance row lock adds a lock to the after_insert path; Kit Attend locks Employee first, the fours endpoint takes only the Attendance lock, so no lock cycle is expected, but the lab should run a concurrent punch burst.
#186: saving end_date on a submitted Shift Assignment runs HRMS on_update_after_submit; assignments HRMS refuses to update are logged and left (as cancel failures were).
#182/#253 make cancellation stricter: some cancels that passed before (partial returns, amendments) are now refused with the existing 'Delivery Note still submitted' message.
All tests here are stub-frappe unit tests; real hooks, ERPNext validation and permissions need the lab rehearsal listed per finding.
open_questions: #173: should the fast track also require a configured auto-cancel / 'may request fast-track' role (the verifier's stronger option)? Implemented only the read (company-scoped) check to keep the feature's audience.

#183: should the DN-return credit flow become atomic (build/validate the uplift note before submitting the base credit, re-raise instead of swallowing in on_submit)? Left as is: re-raising would block the store keeper's return submit.
#165: should landed cost skip customer-specific / batch / validity-window Item Prices? Unchanged here.
#174: rotate the API token hard-coded in biometric-sync-src SendBiometricLogsToERP.php (verifier note; outside this repo).
#256 (minor, left): should the store-only goods-return guard be limited to companies with enable_selling_automations?
